description: This file contains utility functions, classes, and context managers for tracing, metadata management, and provenance tracking within the torch.fx framework, specifically related to node source information, graph provenance, and memory profiling.

classes.name: NodeSourceAction
classes.description: Enum class representing actions for node source provenance, either CREATE or REPLACE.

classes.name: NodeSource
classes.description: Data structure containing provenance information of a node, including its origin, target, and associated metadata.

methods.name: _register_fx_metadata
methods.description: Registers FX metadata in a global in-memory registry for later use by memory profiler.

methods.name: _from_dict
methods.description: Deserializes a NodeSource object from a dictionary, reconstructing nested from_node metadata.

methods.name: print_readable
methods.description: Returns a human-readable string representation of the NodeSource object.

methods.name: to_dict
methods.description: Serializes the NodeSource object into a dictionary for storage or transmission.

methods.name: set_stack_trace
methods.description: Sets the current stack trace in the current_meta if node meta preservation is enabled.

methods.name: annotate
methods.description: Context manager to temporarily add custom annotations to the current tracing context.

methods.name: annotate_fn
methods.description: Decorator to wrap a function so that all operations within it are annotated with specified metadata.

methods.name: set_grad_fn_seq_nr
methods.description: Sets a sequence number for gradient function tracking in current_meta.

methods.name: reset_grad_fn_seq_nr
methods.description: Resets gradient function sequence number tracking in current_meta.

methods.name: format_stack
methods.description: Returns the current stack trace, either from current_meta or via traceback.

methods.name: has_preserved_node_meta
methods.description: Checks if node meta preservation is enabled.

methods.name: set_current_meta
methods.description: Context manager to set current_meta to a node's meta for provenance tracking.

methods.name: set_current_replay_node
methods.description: Context manager to set the current replay node for re-generation in functional mode.

methods.name: get_graph_provenance_json
methods.description: Generates a JSON object with provenance info for each node in a given fx.Graph.

methods.name: _get_custom_metadata
methods.description: Extracts custom metadata from a GraphModule for debugging or analysis.
